name: client-cart-serviceability-checkout-order-create
executionConcern: cart, serviceability, checkout intent and exactly-once order creation
objective: Close the customer purchase path from governed cart through canonical address/serviceability/payment decision and checkout intent to exactly-once DSH order creation with immutable commercial/address snapshots.
truthOwner: DSH owns cart/checkout/order operational truth and serviceability; WLT owns financial truth referenced by checkout/order.
journeys: exactly-once order creation and immediate canonical readback

tasks.objective: Close cart, serviceability, checkout and order-creation invariants
tasks.currentProblem: ClientCheckoutRoute gates on auth/store/address and cart has governed/conflict UI, but Product Truth requires one canonical operational-policy decision and exactly one order per valid checkout intent under retries/concurrency.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace cart mutations, pricing snapshots, address binding, evaluateDshOperationalPolicy, checkout intent, payment eligibility and order creation through contracts/handlers/database; repair idempotency, version, authorization or snapshot divergence at the owner.
tasks.targetState: Denied/paused/disabled/unserviceable checkout cannot proceed; valid retries converge to one order; created order snapshots do not silently reprice or rebind to live catalog/address.
tasks.action: Fix DSH policy/cart/checkout/order owners and database constraints transactionally, then update client state mapping and remove any optimistic final truth.
mustNotChange: Do not let frontend status alone authorize actions.
Do not create order before canonical checkout eligibility.
Do not duplicate an order for retry/concurrent submit.
Do not move wallet/ledger mutation into DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Serviceability and fulfillment modes fail closed on canonical denial.
Concurrent/repeated submit creates one order and returns same operational truth.
Order items/prices/address/fulfillment snapshot is stable after creation.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore a parallel truth source.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U003 implementation commit after owner correction, directly affected consumer migration, cleanup and all linked checks.
